story.soThat: I can easily switch between, create, rename, and delete conversations

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Conversations listed in sidebar, grouped by date (Today, Yesterday, Previous 7 Days, Older)
Each conversation item shows title, last message timestamp, and truncated preview
Click on conversation switches to that conversation
Delete conversation available via context menu or swipe (with confirmation)
Rename conversation via inline edit (double-click or edit icon)
Conversations fetched from backend API on load
Empty state for new users with no conversations
Conversations persist across sessions (backed by Redis)
Real-time update when new message sent (optimistic UI)

doc.title: Epic 20 Technical Context
doc.snippet: Defines the conversation API contract: GET/POST/DELETE/PATCH /api/conversations endpoints with request/response schemas. Also documents Zustand store structure with conversations state and activeConversationId.

doc.title: Epic 20: Annie Web UI PRD
doc.snippet: Full requirements for conversation sidebar including date grouping, CRUD operations, persistence in Redis/PostgreSQL, loading states, and empty state handling. Estimates 1 day effort.

doc.title: Story 20.2: Layout & Navigation Shell
doc.snippet: Defines Sidebar.tsx component structure with ConversationList placeholder. This story must integrate ConversationList into the existing Sidebar component.

doc.title: Story 20.14: Backend API Extensions
doc.section: API Design and Redis Key Structure
doc.snippet: Documents backend conversation endpoints this story consumes: GET/POST/DELETE/PATCH /api/conversations. Also details Redis key patterns for conversations:{user_id} sorted set and conversation:{conv_id}:meta hash.

doc.title: Project Documentation
doc.snippet: Annie uses a microservices architecture with Backend API (FastAPI), MCP Server, and Telegram Bot. Redis handles state management. Backend API includes /api/chat and /api/stream endpoints.

file.reason: Existing chat endpoint patterns and conversation history retrieval. Shows Pydantic model patterns and StateManager usage that story 20.14 will extend for conversation CRUD.

Core state management with Redis patterns for sessions and conversations. Story 20.14 extends this with conversation list methods. This story's useConversations hook will call APIs built on these patterns.
Router registration pattern. Story 20.14 will add conversations router here.

constraints.constraint: Story 20.14 (Backend API Extensions) must provide /api/conversations endpoints before this story can be fully implemented. This story can be partially implemented with mock data.
Story 20.2 (Layout & Navigation Shell) must provide Sidebar.tsx component with placeholder for conversation list integration.
Use Zustand for state management following appStore.ts patterns from tech context.
Use shadcn/ui components for dialog (confirmation), dropdown-menu (context menu), scroll-area.
Use Tailwind CSS for styling with dark mode support via 'class' strategy.
Date grouping must use: Today, Yesterday, Previous 7 Days, Older categories as specified in story.
Loading skeleton should match conversation item dimensions for smooth transition.
Empty state should be friendly and guide users to start chatting.
All interactive elements must have proper ARIA labels and keyboard navigation support.
Implement optimistic UI updates for snappy feel - update local state immediately, then sync with server.

interface.name: Conversation API
Conversation Model
AppState Zustand Store
useConversations Hook

tests.standards: Frontend tests use Jest + React Testing Library. Test components in isolation with mocked hooks/stores. Test hooks with custom renderHook wrapper. Backend tests use pytest with pytest-asyncio for async tests. Mock Redis and external services. Tests organized in unit/, integration/, and e2e/ directories.

ideas.idea: Test ConversationList renders conversations grouped by Today/Yesterday/Previous 7 Days/Older based on updated_at
Test ConversationItem displays title, timestamp formatted as relative time, and truncated preview (max 60 chars)
Test clicking ConversationItem calls setActiveConversation with correct id
Test active conversation has distinct background styling (bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800)
Test clicking New Conversation button calls createConversation and switches to new conversation
Test delete flow: context menu opens, confirmation dialog shows, API called on confirm, item removed from list
Test rename flow: double-click enables edit mode, Enter saves, Escape cancels, blur saves
Test useConversations fetches from API on mount
Test loading skeleton displays correct number of placeholder items during fetch
Test empty state component renders when conversations array is empty
Test conversations persist by verifying API calls are made correctly (integration)
Test optimistic update: UI updates immediately, then syncs with server response
